spec2def(midimap.dll midimap.spec)

# midimap.dll is C, and cargo compiles and links it:
# sdk/lib/rust/midimap-cargo (reactos-link, generated by tools/cargo_cell_gen.py).
# The C still compiled, in an OBJECT library whose compile the cargo link replays.
add_library(midimap_shims OBJECT midimap.c)
target_link_libraries(midimap_shims PRIVATE uuid wine libadvapi32 libuser32 libwinmm libmsvcrt libkernel32 libntdll)
target_compile_definitions(midimap_shims PRIVATE UNICODE _UNICODE)
add_cargo_module(midimap midimap-cargo midimap.dll
    KIND win32dll
    DESTINATION reactos/system32
    EXTRA_DEPENDS midimap_shims psdk uuid_sources)
